classification: Bounded development acquisition comparison; constructed capacity control is separate.

costs.scope: Every completed/failed attempt, replay and local perturbation. Dense forward operations are not full training FLOPs.

decision.capacity: Independently verified a constructed successful parameter setting inside the original 1804-parameter family; not learned performance.
decision.direct_baseline: Own nonlinear pilot fits tiny data at the lower rate but fails larger one-step acquisition at both rates.
decision.learned_result: Both mapping families acquire nonlinear one-step behavior in individual seeds; neither acquires in all three seeds at a common condition.
decision.next: Separately register current-encoder affine identification versus joint gradient fitting, with sufficient permitted training support and explicit rank/regularization handling. Do not enlarge widths or add consistency now.
decision.reversibility: Preserves reconstruction at every saved measurement and has higher mean validation accuracy at both rates, but does not improve passing-seed counts or establish reliable acquisition.
decision.scope: Bounded component calibration; no foundation, compression, broad capability, continual adaptation or practical speed advantage claim.

perturbation_interpretation: At initialization, encoder-only and decoder-only prediction SGD steps reduce prediction MSE while increasing reconstruction MSE by small amounts; complete reconstruction accuracy remains within tolerance.
